edition_detail: API SPECIFICATION 12B SEVENTEENTH EDITION, DECEMBER 2020; API MONOGRAM PROGRAM EFFECTIVE DATE: JUNE 2021; ERRATA 1, NOVEMBER 2024

clause_notes.Section 7: Printed '7 Marking' by the document itself, immediately after Section '8 Inspection' rather than before it — 8's own sub-clauses are likewise printed '8.1 Notice' then '6.1 Inspection by purchaser' and '6.2 Compliance' (not 8.2/8.3). The same out-of-sequence numbers appear independently in this document's own Contents page ('8 Inspection ... 6.1 Inspection by purchaser ... 6.2 Compliance ... 7 Marking'), so this is the standard's own printed numbering, not a transcription artefact — kept as printed rather than renumbered into sequence.
clause_notes.Appendix (unlettered): Printed as a bare '(informative)' heading followed by 'Suggestions for Ordering Tanks', with no 'Annex X' letter — unlike API 12D's and API 12F's parallel informative ordering-guidance annex, which are lettered. Filed as an unlettered appendix rather than assigned a letter the document itself does not print.
